name: Disposition Orchestrator V0.1
description: Disposition Orchestrator triages PRODMGMT tickets so PMs don't read every one manually. Give it a ticket ID and it searches Jira, Confluence, and GitHub to disposition features — already exists, similar, duplicate, or net new — with confidence scores and links. It flags comment blockers and checks value stream fit. Ends with a clear next action for the PM to validate.
triggerExamples: Disposition PRODMGMT-231
Triage this feature request ticket for me
Is this a duplicate of something we already built? Check PRODMGMT-88
Check if PRODMGMT-140 already exists somewhere in the codebase
Run disposition on this ticket and give me a confidence score
Does this feature fit our value stream? Check ticket PRODMGMT-52
Find similar or duplicate features for this Jira ticket
What's the next action I should take on PRODMGMT-77?
